what: Several cards (22.1% wide) overlap evenly across the row width, each standing tilted −5 to 6°. When the cursor moves horizontally over the row, the card at that spot (row width ÷ number of slots) straightens up, lifts 1.2 slots, and steps to the front at 1.04 scale with a deep shadow (.55s). The cards before it crowd to the left and the cards after it crowd to the right, tightening their gaps to a minimum of 1.6% and leaving 1.8% gaps on both sides of the open card (position .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)). Nothing changes while the cursor is over the open card, and when it leaves the row the cards return to their even spots and their own tilt. Below 1024px it becomes a horizontally swipeable row.

options.[data-fx-part=card]·[data-fx-part=face]: Card slot (moves with left) and the tilting, rising panel inside it
options.card: Card width (% of row width), default 22.1
options.gap·min·over: Gap around the open card, minimum gap when crowded, overhang at both ends (%), defaults 1.8 · 1.6 · 4
options.ref: If the line is wider than this width (rem), values scale down by that ratio, default 82
options.shuffle: When true, shuffles the card order each time it opens (original) — keep the default
options.breakpoint: Width at which the fan opens, default 1024
options.--fx-tilt·--fx-dy: Per-card tilt and sag (slot), default is an 8-card cycle of −4·3·−2·5·−5·2·6·−3°

note: Unlike fan-focus-cards (pushing cards by inverse distance from the hovered card), this picks a card by the cursor’s horizontal position and compresses the rest toward both sides of the open card
